title: thlaspi eigii subsp. samuelssonii
intro: Thlaspi eigii subsp. samuelssonii, commonly known as Swedish rock-cress, is a plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Swedish rock-cress are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce stress, and exhibit neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
